name: liqo-ig-concierge
description: LIQO Instagram DM concierge for Amaflip India Pvt. Ltd. — D1 data layer, Hono Worker API, command.amaflip.in dashboard, BUSY attribution importer. The DM loop itself runs in n8n.

scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace worker run typecheck && npm --workspace dashboard run typecheck
scripts.db:apply: wrangler d1 execute liqo_concierge --local --config worker/wrangler.toml --file schema/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute liqo_concierge --local --config worker/wrangler.toml --file schema/seed.sql
scripts.db:apply:remote: wrangler d1 execute liqo_concierge --remote --yes --config worker/wrangler.toml --file schema/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute liqo_concierge --remote --yes --config worker/wrangler.toml --file schema/seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply liqo_concierge --local --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply liqo_concierge --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:demo: wrangler d1 execute liqo_concierge --local --config worker/wrangler.toml --file schema/seed_demo.sql
scripts.deploy:dashboard: npm --workspace dashboard run build && wrangler pages deploy dashboard/dist --project-name=liqo-command
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:worker && npm run deploy:dashboard
